name: Directus
summary: Headless CMS and data platform with an API.
description: Directus puts an admin app and a REST and GraphQL API on top of a database, so your team edits the content and your websites and apps read it. For developers and agencies who build sites with a headless CMS.
licence_note: Free for production use by an organisation whose yearly revenue, budget or funding is less than 5 million US dollars. A larger organisation needs a licence from Directus.

settings.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
settings.label: Admin email
settings.help: You sign in with this email. The password is in the environment variable ADMIN_PASSWORD.

whats_new: The first version of the template.
first_steps: Sign in with your admin email and the password in the environment variable ADMIN_PASSWORD (Environment, Reveal). Change the password in Directus: a change of the variable later does not change it. The first start makes the database and takes about a minute.
